data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'atle', meaning 'man' or 'noble one'. In Greek mythology, Atlee was a hero who defeated the giant Enceladus. The name Atlee carries the meaning “Man, noble one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Atlee usually hope their child will grow to embody man, noble one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Atlee belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man, noble one.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Atlee total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
